name: memtoad
description: Persistent project memory for Claude Code — diary-based session continuity, architectural decisions, and lessons learned. Optional enhanced memory: a local, git-tracked database keeps the full text of every decision and lesson, so the diary can stay detailed and span the whole life of a project while each session reads only a compact Index (opt in with /bootstrap; needs Python 3.12+). Entries that stop applying are labelled superseded or retired, never deleted, and the session log keeps only active work. Run /bootstrap to set up a new project, /startup to load context, /committer to document before committing.
